english: …You want me to hand over Tiffania?
Yes. Zero's Louise's friend,\nTiffania Westwood. You've got her\nsecured, don't you?
You've got a trump card in hand,\nso why not use it? I've been wondering.
I'm afraid that's not possiblee.
Huhh? What's that supposed to mean?
I promised to guarantee her safety…\nthat's the deal.
Keep… promises.
Come on, just break that promise.
That goes against our principles.\nWe cannot hand over Tiffania.
The client is interested in the bearer of Void.
I know. That's why we're keeping\nTiffania in our custody.
So why does that lead to NOT using Tiffania\nto catch Louise? I just don't get it at aall.
How honest of you to admit\nyou can't catch her with your own strength.
I just hate hassle.\nIf I accidentally killed her,\nthe client would be mad, y'know?
Well, whatever.\nI'll just tell the client you refused\nto hand her over?
Then what'll happen to-what was it,\nthe Black Fund? Your organization and boss?
You…!
Think whatever you want.\nLiving while picking and choosing my methods\njust isn't Riko's way.
…What do you plan to do with her?
Riko just gets what she's told to get.\nNothing else interests me.
That's… not okay…!
Got attached? How soft.
// Scene change\n// Background: inside Butei High
Miss Valliere! Where are you, Miss Valliere!
Siesta. What's wrong?
I haven't seen Miss Valliere\nsince this morning. Have you seen her?
Whaaat!? She's being targeted,\nand after we told her so many times\nnot to go off alone!
I'm sorry!\nWhen I woke up, she was gone from beside me…
I saw Louise a bit ago.\nShe's probably still inside Butei High.
Let's all look for her!
// Scene change\n// Background: school hallway\n// Louise alone, looking for the bath.
…Umm, where is it, I wonder?
Louise? What are you doing!
Oh, perfect timing.\nHey, where's the bath?
The bath?
I want to take a bath alone.\nJust because I'm being targeted,\nsomeone's always with me.
I just want to soak in the bath\nalone in peace!
And when we bathe together,\nI can't help comparing and it irritates me!\nYou'd understand, right?
Yeah, I get it… Louise.
Right, right!
But I also get why everyone wants\nto bathe with you, Louise.
Huh?
'Cause you're cute…
Wh-wh-what are you saying!?\nYou're into that sort of thing!?
Dunno. But looking at Louise,\nI feel like… we're not strangers, somehow…
D-don't come closer!
Hey, Louisee.\nWanna do naughty things with me?
Eeep!? No, don't touch me…!
Just kidding! It was a joke!
Huh!? What was that!?
Well, I'm off.\nI'll be waiting. Fufu.
Wh-what was that Aria just now…\nDefinitely weird… huh?
This… a letter? When did she…!?
…To Louise.\nCome alone to the place shown on the map.\nReporting to your comrades is forbidden.
If you keep the promise…\nthey'll return Tiffania!?
Tifa…!!
// Scene change\n// Battle map: forest\n// Louise deployed with allies; Aria (Riko in disguise) deployed with enemies.
Aha♪ You came, Louisee.
We're both flat as boards,\nso how about we two head off\nto the forbidden world togetherr?
…Stop fooling around.\nWhy don't you drop the bad impression?
…Fufu.
// Aria drops her disguise, becoming Riko.
Did you really come alonee?
A noble doesn't break promises.
Oh, good for you.\nRiko'll give you a round of applause.
More importantly, where's Tifa?\nI don't see her.
Before that, hear me out a little.
Don't you want to explore the true worth\nof your Void magic-its real purpose?
…The letter said if I came alone,\nyou'd return Tifa. There was no condition\nabout listening to any talk.
So you won't talk this out peacefully?
Let me put it plainly.\nGive Tifa back, now!
…You're just like the person\nRiko hates most. You could be sisters.
Bring out Tifa!
That arrogance! That nerve!\nIt pisses me off!!
Shut up!\nYou're pissing me off too!
Don't you care what happens to your friend?\nYou should be groveling and begging\nto see her!
I went out of my way to come here,\nso YOU bow your head and thank ME!
Is that so… can you keep up\nthat attitude after seeing this?
// Tifa appears, flanked on both sides by grunt bandit units. She appears near Riko.
Tifa!
Louise! Run! It's a trap!
I don't care about traps!\nTifa risked her life to save me!
I thought I might never even get\nto say thank you! So…!
That's enough.\nYou know what happens if you resist, right?
Just so you know, Riko hates\nthis kind of barbaric approach, but-\ndon't forget whose fault this is, okay?
Give Tifa back, you rotten woman!\nIf you do anything weird to Tifa,\nI'll never forgive you!
…Seriously pissing me off. Have you really\nlived like that all this time?\nThat doesn't fly here!!
Shut up! A self-proclaimed phantom thief\nwho only ever fails has no right\nordering ME around!!
Don't you get your position here!!\nGrovel and beg for mercy, wailing!
Acting tough won't help!\nHow about Mine Riko, with zero achievements,\nrenames herself Lupin the Zero?
Don't screw with meeeee!!
Ahahaha! You're mad, you're mad!\nA phantom thief with no shred of composure?\nAren't you just stuuupid!?
Shut up!! Shut up shut up shut up!!\nSay one more word and I'll finish her off!!
…Could you, I wonder?
What!?
Need Is Algeez…\nBerkana Man Lagoo!
// The forgetting spell activates\non the grunt units holding Tifa.
A spell!?
Who do you think we are?\nBearers of Void-mages.
Damn it, cut Tiffania to pieces!\nI'll show you!!
Wh-what!? What's wrong!?
Everyone.\nShouldn't you hurry home?
// The grunt units run off and vanish
Impossible…!?
I had them forget. Their role.
Tifa's forgetting spell.\nYou were so enraged by my insults,\nyou noticed the chanting too late.
No way… that was the plan\nfrom the start!?
Did you think I angered you\nwithout thinking?
Don't mess with me! It's just two of you!\nI'll capture you both!!
// Grunt units appear
Hmm, then I'll call mine too.\nCome out!
What!?
// Allied units appear
No way… where were they hiding!?
I told you. I'm a mage.
Illusion-Louise's spell that shows visions.\nThey must've looked like grass and trees to you!
Holmes!!
Who's 'flat as boards' together!\nI had to hold myself back from punching\na hole through you!!
Didn't you say a noble doesn't break promises!
Who tried to lay hands on Tifa?\nYou're the one who broke the promise.
Yooouuu!!
Shall we step in about now?
I'll be your opponent!
Wait, everyone!\nFirst get Tifa somewhere safe!
Exactly! We'll cover her!\nShe's not going to the enemy!
Tifa! Run!
Yes!
Like hell I'll let you!!
// Battle start\n// Objective: move Tifa to the designated position
Haa, haa… if I can get this far…!
All right, she's safe!
Too naive!
// A grunt bandit unit appears next to Tifa.
Ah!
An ambush in a place like that!?
Ahahaha! Grab her!\nI'm the one who wins in the end!
Tifaaa!
// SE: gunshot.\n// The bandit's HP hits zero and it falls.
Gih!?
A sniper!? From where!?
Who? What was that?
Wasn't us!\nIt came from a different direction…!
Damn it, what's going on…
…Got any more tricks? If so, use them!
Tch… this wasn't supposed to happen…\ndamn it!!
I'll repay this debt, no matter what!
// Riko vanishes.\n// Battle end.\n// Background: forest
…Phew.\nThat was close, but we managed.
Louiseee!
Uph!?
We met! We finally met!\nThank you so much!
H-hey! O-okay, I get it! I can't breathe!\nMy face is buried in your cleavage… mmmph…!
S-sorry. I was so happy, I just…
Geez, still huge as ever!\nDon't those things ever deflate, I wonder…
Wooow…
My…
Off the charts…
Hoho, tonight's bath should be fun…
Sis, you're drooling…
(Indeed, there'll be much to look forward to.)
(Hey, what exactly are you imagining…)
(Journeys are full of little happenings, no?)
(No, I don't get what you mean…)
Tifa… welcome back.
Siesta…
I've been worried this whole time.\nI'm glad you're safe… truly…
Don't cry. Geez…
Louise, introduce her properly.
I know! This is Tiffania Westwood.\nShe's an elf, and…
An elf?
Ah! I forgot to hide my ears…
Hey, forget the ears-\ncan't you do something about those?
Huh?
We all come from different worlds and cultures.\nBut if we cherish each other's feelings,\ndifferences are trivial.
Shirayuki's right.\nAfter seeing magic, not much surprises me anymore.
Anyone's welcome here!\nLet's be friends!
Will I be all right?
If Louise is fine, you'll be fine!
What's that supposed to mean!?
Tonight's Tifa's welcome party!\nI'll go all out on the cooking!
Leave the Japanese food to me!
This is my time to shine!
No, it's mine!
Not Cecilia!!
Everyone's so mean!!
// Fade to black\n// Background: forest\n// Aria picking up a bullet.
…Found it.
Aria, what's that?
A bullet.
Ah, the one that took out the ambusher?\nI wonder who that was.
I recognize this bullet.\nI don't think it was standard issue.\nA sniper who uses these is…
// Scene change\n// Background: mountains or some natural scenery. The Twin Phantoms with Reki, finished sniping.
Tiffania Westwood's protection:\nmission complete.
Thank youuu.\nA difficult job, but splendidly donee.
…Thanks.
I always honor my contract with the client. That's all.
…Contact me again if needed.
// Reki leaves.
Skilled, but an unfriendly girl.
Fufu, but I don't dislike that type…
…Sis.
…Is it okay?
Worried about when it's found out?\nThis is Riko's own doing.
I'm looking forward to seeing\nhow Riko makes up for losing Tifa.
…What about Tifa?
If we took her back here,\nRiko would lose face. Unless ordered,\nwe won't interfere.
…Good.
(She looked lonely on her own…)
//END
